definition: things piling up behind a blockage
description: A jammed baggage belt in an airport arrivals hall. The view starts close on a big black suitcase and pulls back: suitcases and bags are piled high and stuck on the carousel, with a yellow suitcase on top of the pile. A young man in a cream jacket pulls hard at the black suitcase, a young woman in a camel coat holding a red suitcase watches beside him, and a worker in an orange high-visibility vest sorts the pile. Other travellers wait with trolleys by the big windows.

taps.phrase: to tug at a heavy suitcase
